badgeTips.independent_2plus: Two or more separate documents agree.
badgeTips.conflicting: Two documents disagree. Both are shown.

flagTips.echo: This medicine block was copied word for word from an older document. It is not new evidence.
flagTips.handwriting: Read from a handwritten page by an AI model on this computer. Doctor: check it against the original image.
flagTips.contradiction: Two documents disagree. Both are shown. Your doctor will check it.
flagTips.duplicate: This document is an exact copy of another. It is counted once.
flagTips.unit_mismatch: The same test is reported in different units. Values are shown exactly as written. Nothing is converted.
flagTips.ambiguous_date: This date could be read two ways (day/month). Both readings are shown.
flagTips.wrong_patient: This report may belong to someone else. It is held back until a doctor checks it.
flagTips.implausible_value: This value looks impossible. It may be a typing or scanning error. The original is unchanged.
flagTips.gap: Not in your records. This does not mean you don't have it.

landing.title: Other apps summarise your records.
landing.titleAccent: Pramaan knows what it doesn't know.
landing.lead: Pramaan turns scattered prescriptions, lab reports and discharge summaries into one dated health timeline. Every fact links to the exact line it came from. Gaps, contradictions and copies are shown, never hidden.

demo.label: From the timeline
demo.note: Mentioned in 3 documents. 2 are copies. Last real evidence: 2019.
demo.gapNote: Not written anywhere does not mean "no allergies".

landing.featuresTitle: Built to be checked, not just trusted

proof.title: Click to proof
proof.text: Open any fact and see the source document with the exact line highlighted.

quote.title: No quote, no fact
quote.text: A fact is kept only if its words are found in the document. Nothing is made up.

echo.title: Copies spotted
echo.text: A medicine list copied from an old record counts as one piece of evidence, not four.

gaps.title: Gaps shown
gaps.text: "Not documented" is never treated as "does not have". Missing items become questions.

wrong.title: Wrong-patient check
wrong.text: A report whose blood group or sex doesn't match is held back until someone checks it.

ask.title: Ask my records
ask.text: Answers come only from your records, with sources. Otherwise: "The records don't mention this."

upload.title: Upload
upload.text: Add your prescriptions, lab reports and discharge summaries as PDFs.

verify.title: Verify
verify.text: Names and IDs are hidden before any AI reads them. Every fact is checked against its source line.

review.title: Review
review.text: See a dated timeline with flags and trust badges. Answer open questions; your doctor confirms.

landing.privacyLead: Built following the safeguards of GDPR, the EU AI Act and India's DPDP Act.

privacy.deid: Names, phone numbers and IDs removed before any AI call
privacy.audit: Audit log of who saw what
privacy.delete: Delete all your data at any time

landing.closing: A fluent summary asks you to trust it. Pramaan gives you a history you can verify.
landing.footerDemo: Demo with synthetic patient data only.
